description.value: Fanny Bay Oyster Bar is a Michelin-recommended seafood restaurant and retail shellfish market in Vancouver's stadium district, serving freshly shucked oysters and BC shellfish farmed directly by the Taylor Shellfish family for over 40 years. Cyclists will find a full dine-in oyster bar alongside a retail shellfish market with online ordering for pickup, located near BC Place at 762 Cambie Street.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website fully corroborates the OSM address (762 Cambie Street, Vancouver, BC V6B 2P2) and phone number (778-379-9510), and confirms an active Michelin-recommended oyster bar with dine-in service and an onsite shellfish market offering online ordering for retail pickup. No bike-specific amenities, water refill, washroom facilities, Wi-Fi, or device charging are mentioned anywhere on the site. The explicit statement that prepared raw shellfish cannot be taken to go, combined with the active retail market for live shellfish, shapes the takeout assessment.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Clearly operational Food & Drink business at a confirmed Vancouver address with a retail shellfish market offering takeout pickup — a legitimate stop for touring cyclists riding through downtown Vancouver.
enrichment_extras.notes: OSM outdoor_seating=no is consistent with the website, which mentions only indoor dine-in. No bike amenities could be confirmed; a site visit would be needed to assess bike parking options given the urban stadium-district location.

Takeout.detail: Onsite Shellfish Market offers retail pickup of live shellfish; online ordering available with same-day pickup. Note: prepared dine-in shellfish explicitly cannot be taken to go per the website
